summary.tldr: Requires a House of Commons seat to be vacated and a by-election called when an MP changes party affiliation.
what_it_does: Adds a rule that a person in the House of Commons is deemed to have vacated their seat if they join a registered party after being elected for a different party or as an independent.
Requires the leader of the party that the person joins to notify the Speaker of the House of Commons in writing without delay.
Requires the Speaker, or the party leader in some cases, to send a warrant to the Chief Electoral Officer for a writ to fill the vacancy by election.
who_it_affects: Members of the House of Commons
summary.background: The bill amends the Parliament of Canada Act by adding a new rule on change of political affiliation in the House of Commons.
